definition: תַּעֲלוּלִים noun [masculine] plural abstract wantonness, caprice ; — יִמְשְׁלוּ בָם ׳ ת Isa 3:4 caprice shall rule over them ; suffix תַּעֲלֻלֵיהֶם Isa 66:4 their wanton dealing , i.e. that inflicted on them.
